CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS query_execution_logs (id INT PRIMARY KEY, query_id INT, execution_time_ms INT, wait_type NVARCHAR(64))

tables.name: synthetic_queries
tables.purpose: Simulate queries with high memory grants and parallelism to reproduce RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE waits.
tables.distribution_notes: Queries designed to simulate high memory pressure and parallel execution.

tables.name: query_execution_logs
tables.purpose: Log execution metrics and wait types for synthetic queries.
tables.distribution_notes: Logs capturing execution time and wait types for analysis.

value_skew.synthetic_queries.memory_grant: High memory grants skewed towards specific queries.

calibration_queries.sql: SELECT * FROM synthetic_queries WHERE memory_grant > 50 AND parallelism > 8
calibration_queries.objective: Verify that the synthetic data triggers RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE waits under high parallelism and memory grants.
expected_evidence: Execution plan shows high memory grants and parallelism.
RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE waits are visible in execution logs.
